messages.content: What would be the predicted forest growth in the Amazon Rainforest and the Boreal Forests of Canada over the next 10 years and 20 years, respectively, if we do not include the impact of human activities?

include_human_impact.description: Whether or not to include the impact of human activities in the forecast. If not provided, defaults to false.
